note: One dot per release, diamonds for prereleases. Repos with zero releases in the selected span aren't shown on the chart (see the table for those).
methodology: Fetch every published, non-draft release for each repo in the org (GitHub Releases only, no git-tag fallback).
Filter to the selected span (Week / 1 month / 1 year / Last 18 months).
Plot one point per release, sorted top-to-bottom by release count within that span.
Label each row with its exact count instead of relying on dot density, which would distort under high cadence.
population: Each published GitHub release, by repository and publication time (UTC). Drafts are excluded; prereleases are marked. Repositories with no release in the window are not shown.
